basic_details.job_title: GTU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Gujarat Technological University (GTU) has notified 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow post on a project-based and purely contractual basis initially for 1 year and extendable to one more year or until the completion of project whichever is earlier, subject to satisfactory performance of the candidate. The qualification required is a Post Graduate Degree in Biotechnology/Microbiology/Biochemistry/Life Sciences with NET/GATE/ICMR/any other National Eligibility Tests or without them. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following educational qualifications and age criteria: 1. Post Graduate Degree in Biotechnology/Microbiology/Biochemistry/Life Sciences with NET/GATE/ ICMR/ any other National Eligibility Tests; OR 2. Post Graduate Degree in Biotechnology/Microbiology/Biochemistry/Life Sciences. Research experience in the field of molecular biology techniques, handling animal cell culture and bioinformatics with scientific writing and good communication skills. Preferably below 35 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions will be purely on a contractual basis initially for 1 year and extendable to one more year or until the completion of project whichever is earlier, subject to satisfactory performance of the candidate. Fellowship remuneration is structured as follows: A. For candidates having qualifications (as per DST, GoI, Office memorandum SR/S9/Z-08 /2018 Dt. 30/01/2019) mentioned at no. 1: The fellowship as per GSBTM will be Rs. 31,000/- + HRA (The candidate will be paid 20% HRA of previous fellowship Rs. 25,000/- (as per DST, GoI, Office memorandum SR/S9/Z-09 /2012 Dt. 21/10/2014)). B. For candidates having qualifications mentioned at no. 2: The fellowship as per GSBTM will be Rs. 23,213/- Fixed (HRA will not be entitled). FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GTU Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates are requested to send their detailed CV on plain paper and documents/certificates/testimonials in support of their claims to the e-mail address [email protected] before 26.10.2026. Documents named in the notice: Detailed CV on plain paper Documents/certificates/testimonials in support of their claims

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on their qualifications and experience. The interview date will be intimated by email and have to appear for the interview at their own expense (No TA/DA shall be provided).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for GTU Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GTU Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is before 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for GTU Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Post Graduate Degree in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, or Life Sciences, with or without NET, GATE, ICMR, or other National Eligibility Tests.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GTU Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates should preferably be below 35 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship amount for GTU Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates with NET/GATE receive Rs. 31,000 per month plus 20% HRA (calculated on Rs. 25,000), while candidates without NET/GATE receive a fixed fellowship of Rs. 23,213 per month without HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GTU Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The notice does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for GTU Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates must email their detailed CV on plain paper along with documents/certificates/testimonials in support of their claims to [email protected] before 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GTU Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting according to qualifications and experience, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the GTU Junior Research Fellow post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The post is purely contractual, initially for 1 year and extendable to one more year or until the completion of project whichever is earlier, subject to satisfactory performance of the candidate.

faq.question: Q10. What are the desired skills for GTU Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The desired skills are research experience in the field of molecular biology techniques, handling animal cell culture and bioinformatics with scientific writing and good communication skills.
